description.value: Lang Vineyards holds the distinction of being British Columbia's first farm-gate winery, founded by Guenther Lang in 1990 and home to the oldest vines on the Naramata Bench. Now in its 35th year, this boutique family estate produces a wide range from crisp whites and rosés to dessert wines, with tastings available by reservation. The Naramata Bench is one of the Okanagan's premier cycling corridors, and this historic winery sits directly along that route.
